content.html:
Privacy Policy

Bigchamp is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. We collect only required information like contact numbers and proof of identification for verified defense benefits.

We do not sell your personal data to third parties. All financial transactions are securely processed through regulated payment gateways.

Terms of Service

By registering on the Bigchamp platform or acquiring the ₹100 digital membership card, you agree to comply with all membership guidelines and code of conduct at partner facilities.

Membership cards are non-transferable and valid for an 11-month active duration from issue date.

Refund & Cancellation Policy

Digital membership activation fees are refundable within 48 hours of purchase if no partner discounts or wallet cashback have been redeemed.

Store product returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery for defective items in original packaging.
